REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: Airborne lidar and measurement system
review.buyer: Oulu University of Applied Sciences Ltd
review.description:
REQUEST FOR INFORMATION: Airborne lidar and measurement system REQUEST FOR INFORMATION

Oulu University of Applied Sciences Ltd ("Oamk") is preparing a potential procurement of an airborne lidar and measurement system. Through this Request for Information (RFI), Oamk is conducting a market consultation to identify solutions available on the market, their features, integration possibilities, and suitability for various airborne measurement and mapping tasks. This RFI is not a contract notice or a call for tenders and does not initiate a procurement process.

The market consultation does not oblige Oamk to proceed with the procurement, nor does it create any obligations for suppliers. Participation or non-participation in the market consultation will not affect a supplier's ability to participate in any subsequent competitive tendering process.

The preliminary scope of the procurement is a complete solution suitable for use on unmanned aerial vehicles and, where possible, also on manned aircraft. The solution may include laser scanning equipment, positioning and inertial measurement systems, data storage and integration components, required software, and services related to system commissioning.

This RFI aims to gather information on available alternatives, their suitability, implementation possibilities, and cost levels to support the preparation of the competitive tendering process. The call for tenders is expected to be published in late 2026 or early 2027. The information presented in this RFI is preliminary and may change before the call for tenders is published.,

old.description: DTU requires an operator to design, plan and execute an airborne gravity survey using an airship plat-form. This action is planned within the EU Horizon Europe project called EQUIP-G, where a new quan-tum gravity sensor will be procured and delivered by ultimo 2027 and the survey carried out in fall 2028. The operator will also engage in the identification of possible instrument requirements related to the airship platform and support the design and certification process in order to meet the require-ments. [CPV 60423000 Charterflyvning]

old.title: DT-AG.R10 Rammeaftale om luftbårne ydelser, ortofoto og punktskyer
old.description:
Vejdirektoratet har strategisk vurderet, at ydelsen bedst indkøbes på markedsvilkår fremfor at ansætte medarbejdere, idet opgaven kræver specialistkompetencer eller særlige faglige kompetencer, som ikke er til stede i Vejdirektoratet. Desuden kræver ydelsen droner eller flyvemaskine afhængigt af projektområderne størrelser.  

Vejdirektoratet vurderer at i fremtiden vil blive større behov for ydelserne og at de skal udføres med en højere frekvens, og i den nære fremtids står vi overfor at flere større projekter påbegyndes. Indgåelse af en rammeaftale, der dækker ydelserne vurderes som nødvendig. 

Ydelserne der er omfattet af rammeaftale, består af 3 delaftaler med ydelser indenfor:  

1.Gentagne ortofoto af Vejdirektoratets projekter under anlægsfasen inkl. diverse supplerende ydelser 

2.Punktskyer optaget med LIDAR inkl. samtidige ortofoto. 

3.Højopløselige ortofoto. inkl. diverse supplerende ydelser [CPV 71510000 Forundersøgelse af byggegrund]
